sectionDOM: main > div -> div.section (data-section-status, inline display:none until loaded); runs of default content wrapped in div.default-content-wrapper

fragmentScriptPolicy: inert-innerHTML (trustedTypes default policy strips <script> on createContextualFragment/document-write sinks; delivered CSP is script-src nonce + strict-dynamic)
emptySectionNote: pipeline consumes the metadata block server-side leaving an empty first section; foundation adds main .section:empty { display: none }
fontsMechanism: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css (eager >=900px or fonts-loaded session flag, always in loadLazy); metric fallbacks live in styles.css (roboto-fallback 99.529%, roboto-condensed-fallback 88.82%, both local Arial)
chrome: header/footer blocks fetch /nav and /footer via loadFragment(path + '.plain.html'), overridable per page via nav/footer metadata; header stock machinery: nav-brand/nav-sections/nav-tools sections, hamburger toggleMenu, isDesktop = (min-width: 900px)
autoBlocks: buildAutoBlocks: a[href*='/fragments/'] -> fragment include; a[href*='/widgets/'] -> widget block
stockQuirk: stock header.js references .button-container when unwrapping the brand link but decorateButtons emits .button-wrapper (harmless drift; header.js is replaced by this conversion anyway)
